scope: Ingredient or cleansing-category research only. No CELDYQUE finished-product efficacy studies were supplied.

volufiline.label: Croda Beauty — Volufiline ingredient information
volufiline.limits: Supplier ingredient description, not an independent CELDYQUE product trial. Do not infer facial volume percentages or a filler-equivalent result.

niacinamide.label: Bissett et al. — Niacinamide and facial skin appearance
niacinamide.limits: Randomized split-face study: 50 participants, 5% niacinamide, 12 weeks. Does not test CELDYQUE or establish superiority of 20%.

bakuchiol.label: Dhaliwal et al. — Topical bakuchiol and photoageing
bakuchiol.limits: 44 participants; 0.5% bakuchiol cream twice daily versus 0.5% retinol once daily, 12 weeks. Different formulations and schedules; no CELDYQUE equivalence claim.

panthenol.label: Gehring and Gloor — Dexpanthenol, hydration and barrier function
panthenol.limits: Human vehicle-controlled study of dexpanthenol in lipophilic vehicles. Supports ingredient hydration context, not a CELDYQUE result or hair-growth claim.

pdrn.label: PDRN research in cultured skin cells
pdrn.limits: Laboratory keratinocyte and fibroblast study. Not a topical finished-product trial; no inference of wound healing, post-procedure recovery or injection-equivalent results.

glutathione.label: Watanabe et al. — Topical oxidized glutathione
glutathione.limits: 30 participants, 2% oxidized glutathione lotion, 10 weeks. The CELDYQUE glutathione form has not been matched to the tested material.

azelaic.label: Azelaic acid and facial pigmentation study
azelaic.limits: Study of 20% azelaic acid cream versus vehicle; not the CELDYQUE 12% serum. No transfer of treatment or clinical efficacy claims.

glycerin.label: Lodén and Wessman — Glycerin and skin hydration
glycerin.limits: 17 volunteers; leave-on 20% glycerin cream versus vehicle. Ingredient context only; does not establish rinse-off cleanser moisturization.

cleansing.label: Chen et al. — Cleansing methods for sunscreen removal
cleansing.limits: 20 participants and particular sunscreen/cleanser formulations. Category context, not complete removal of every sunscreen by CELDYQUE.
